Help [[Infantryman Hareh]] retrieve an ancient book of knowledge.

==Quest information==

===Objectives===
* Travel to the ancient temple in [[the Sulfurous Wastes]].
* Retrieve the [[Ancient Tome of Knowledge|ancient tome of knowledge]].
* Return to [[Infantryman Hareh]] with the ancient tome.
* See Infantryman Hareh for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* [[Ancient Artifact]]

==Walkthrough==
After you have accepted the quest, make your way to the monolith temple in the southwestern part of the map. There you have to fight a few [[Margonite]] groups and you can claim the [[Ancient Tome of Knowledge]]. The tome itself is actually lying on the ground at the temple entrance. On your way back, along the path leading out of the southwestern corner, two more Margonite groups will spawn in an attempt to stop you from leaving; but since your party is inside [[Junundu]], they should pose little threat.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
'''Infantryman Hareh'''
:''"Braaiiiins! It's all about brains around here! Just because I'm not a scholar I can't be a commanding officer! Everyone's always giving me orders, telling me what to do... And of course, when the plan goes to hell, it's always blamed on the lowly peons like me. If only I was smarter I could convince someone to give me a chance... then things would go better around here. Maybe you could go to the old temple in the '''Sulfurous Wastes''' and get me an ancient '''tome of knowledge'''! I bet if I spent a few days reading over it, I'd have all the brains I need."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Read books. Get brains. Sounds simple.
|decline = You'll need more than knowledge to fill that gaping hole between your ears.
|ask = Have you found the '''tome of knowledge''' yet? It's in the old temple in the '''Sulfurous Wastes'''. }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Infantryman Hareh'''
:''"Wow, you got it! Thanks so much. Now I can finally become the officer I was meant to be instead of just a lowly gentleman! And to think, dad said I'd never amount to anything. I sure showed him! That tome looks pretty thick, though.... I hope there aren't too many big words in there."''

==Notes==
*Infrantryman Hareh is in a blocked area to the north, which requires you to smash a pillar with [[Junundu Smash]] to gain access (see the [[The Sulfurous Wastes#Notes|notes section of the Sulfurous Wastes]]).
*This quest is popularly used in conjunction with [[A Show of Force]] to farm points for both the [[Sunspear rank]] and the [[Lightbringer rank]] (see [[Lightbringer_rank#Acquisition|Guide to farming Lightbringer promotion points]] for details).
*The quests [[Temple of the Monoliths‎]] and [[A Show of Force]] conclude in the same area; consider doing one of them at the same time as this quest.
*There is a [[Treasure Chest]] inside the temple.

==Trivia==
*The name of the quest is possibly a reference to the movie "[[w:Requiem for a Dream|Requiem for a Dream]]."
*The remark about becoming an officer instead of a lowly gentleman is possibly a reference to the movie "[[w:An officer and a gentleman|An officer and a gentleman]]"
